title: Decision: key_package_claim never pruned; follower_member gets explicit id
description: Audit item 12. Welcome visibility joins key_package_claim (store/follower_log.rs:311, :369); no code deletes from it today. follower_member has no INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (migrations/0003_follower.sql:52-59), so its implicit rowid, used for Chat/ChatContact state, may change on VACUUM (not run today). Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-18): (a) .12.3 must never delete from key_package_claim; (b) migration 0006 (.11.3) rebuilds follower_member with id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, and state strings use it.
